SELECT z.id, z.sn, z.data, z.time, z.tenant_id, z.created_by, z.created_id, z.created_time, z.updated_by, z.updated_id, z.updated_time FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (sub.bucket_start) sub.id, sub.sn, sub.data, sub.time, sub.tenant_id, sub.created_by, sub.created_id, sub.created_time, sub.updated_by, sub.updated_id, sub.updated_time, sub.bucket_start FROM ( SELECT c.id, c.sn, c.data, c.time, c.tenant_id, c.created_by, c.created_id, c.created_time, c.updated_by, c.updated_id, c.updated_time, AS bucket_start FROM t_equip_collect c WHERE c.sn = #{sn} AND c.time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) AS sub ORDER BY sub.bucket_start, sub.time DESC ) AS z ORDER BY z.time ASC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.sql: CASE jsonb_typeof(kv.value) WHEN 'number' THEN (kv.value #>> '{}')::double precision WHEN 'string' THEN CASE WHEN (kv.value #>> '{}') ~ '^[-+]?\d*\.?\d+([eE][-+]?\d+)?$' THEN (kv.value #>> '{}')::double precision ELSE NULL END ELSE NULL END
mapper.select: SELECT t.bucket_start AS bucketStart, t.attr_key AS attrKey, AVG(t.num_v) AS avgVal, MIN(t.num_v) AS minVal, MAX(t.num_v) AS maxVal, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ( SELECT AS bucket_start, kv.key AS attr_key, () AS num_v FROM t_equip_collect c CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(c.data::jsonb) AS kv(key, value) WHERE c.sn = #{sn} AND c.time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND c.data IS NOT NULL ) AS t WHERE t.num_v IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.bucket_start, t.attr_key ORDER BY t.bucket_start ASC, t.attr_key ASC
